tool_input.description: Run in-game test suite and benchmark headlessly in Node
Headless run of the game's built-in test suite and benchmark
Run headless test suite/benchmark, then remove the temp checker
Run headless test suite and benchmark for game.html

claude.result:
Done — the complete game is saved to `./game.html` as a single self-contained file (no other files remain in the directory; I briefly created and removed a headless checker script).

**What's implemented (all 13 systems, in the required priority order):**

- **Core loop** — one JSON-serializable state object, mulberry32 PRNG threaded through the state (no `Math.random` anywhere), seed 1337 editable in the header, and a fixed 9-step turn order documented in the file's header comment.
- **Map** — 8×8 seeded terrain (ash flats, rock, water, vent, ruins), click-to-build with terrain requirements and adjacency bonuses (condenser +50% by water, forge +50% by vent, etc.) shown in tooltips and the build panel.
- **Economy** — 8 stockpiles with caps and logged overflow; real chains: mine→ore→forge(+power)→metal→workshop(+power)→parts, and sifter→soil→greenhouse(+water)→food.
- **Population & needs** — named colonists with job, skill 1–5, fatigue, morale; assignment dropdowns; skill grows with matched work; shortages erode morale, zero-morale colonists refuse work and may leave after a grace turn (visible and recoverable).
- **Research** — 9 nodes with prerequisites and scrip/parts costs; unlocks buildings (Vent Tap, Clinic, Trade Post), boosts yields, cuts storm damage; locked/available/done states shown.
- **Events** — 12 weighted events with cooldowns, 6 of them offering 2–3 choice tradeoffs; unresolved choices auto-default at End Turn so nothing deadlocks.
- **Trade** — caravan visits with limited inventory; prices = base × drifting global multiplier × scarcity relative to your stockpile.
- **Hazards** — ashstorms every 7 turns with turn-scaled severity, water spike, building damage→disable, walls/research mitigation, parts-cost repairs.
- **Save/load** — JSON textarea on the Dev tab with structural validation and clear error messages.
- **End conditions** — win from turn 60 with pop ≥ 12 and needs met, lose at pop 0, scored summary screen.
- **UI** — 6 tabs (keys 1–6), Space ends turn, custom hover/tap tooltips on every number, terrain letters and status text so color is never the only signal, works at 360px.
- **Dev panel** — "Run Tests" (22 assertions: PRNG determinism, terrain determinism, negative-resource and cap invariants over simulated turns, prereq enforcement, slot limits, overflow logging, save/load hash round-trip, sim-hash determinism) and "Run Benchmark" (200-turn greedy headless sim printing a state hash plus stats; same seed → identical hash).

One honest caveat: the sandbox blocked every attempt to execute Node here (`node -e`, running a checker script, even `node --check` all required approval), so I could not machine-run the built-in test suite myself. The suite is one click away though — open `game.html`, press `6` for the Dev tab, and hit **Run Tests** and **Run Benchmark** (twice, to see the identical hash).
